name: ferrochrome
description: The ferrochrome style — a photoreal android/cyborg material language (carbon fibre, chrome, neon) under cinematic-real light. DEFINES a style: this project's deliverable is a trained style LoRA, trigger 'ferrochrome'. Three registers (outcast / cyclops / welded) share ONE rendering law and differ by surface condition, symmetry, seam grammar, and neon. Style-scoped, not game-scoped — reusable by any studio project. GATED: do not generate until the base-model decision in _base_decision is settled by the Director.

_base_decision.status: SETTLED 2026-08-22 by the Director — FLUX.2 [klein] base 4B
_base_decision.rationale: Apache 2.0 (weights AND outputs commercially usable), ~13GB VRAM, the only commercial-safe NON-DISTILLED FLUX.2 base — full training signal, which is the point for a LoRA base. Model KB wave 8 (2026-08-19) calls it 'the ideal game-asset training base on a 32 GB rig'.
_base_decision.supersedes: visual-pipeline skill rule 0 (2026-06) named Qwen-Image as the base. That rule's PURPOSE is NO-ANIME (its forbidden list is Illustrious / Pony / NoobAI, plus SDXL / Chroma / DreamShaper) and FLUX.2 klein does not violate it. The KB row is fresher than the rule per the constitution's 30-day freshness rule. NO ANIME remains absolutely binding.
_base_decision.⛔_DO_NOT_USE: flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors AND flux-2-klein-base-9b* in any form — the 9B klein line is NON-COMMERCIAL. It appears adjacent to the 4B in the same UNETLoader enum and was selected by mistake once already. A LoRA inherits its base licence: training on the 9B makes every downstream asset unsellable. VERIFY THE FILENAME SAYS 4b BEFORE EVERY RUN.
_base_decision._text_encoder_TOCONFIRM: Flux.2 has its own text-encoder loadout and does NOT reuse Flux.1's DualCLIPLoader wiring. Candidates present on Cloud: qwen_3_4b_fp4_flux2.safetensors, mistral_3_small_flux2_bf16.safetensors, mistral_3_small_flux2_fp8.safetensors, mistral_3_small_flux2_fp4_mixed.safetensors. Deliberately NOT guessed here — confirm the correct pairing when the wave-1 workflow is built, via the text_to_image_flux_2_dev subgraph blueprint (CLIPLoader + Flux2Scheduler + EmptyFlux2LatentImage + FluxGuidance + BasicGuider + SamplerCustomAdvanced).

_flux2_prompting_law.negative_prompt: IGNORED by Flux.2 — do not pass one. This removes the 'NOT THAT' negative-prompt technique the rustline/hesperia lineage depends on. Adherence is steered with a guidance node (FluxGuidance), never by raising KSampler cfg above 1.
_flux2_prompting_law.style: natural_language — describe the scene in full sentences, not keyword lists.

_pipeline.generation: Comfy Cloud, OSS checkpoints only — bills as gpu_seconds, and sidesteps the unresolved partner-API training-rights question (Comfy consult #4 Q1: UNKNOWN, agent recommends OSS to make it moot).
_pipeline.training: LOCAL on the 5090. Comfy Cloud has NO weight-export path — SaveLoRA / LoraSave / SaveLoraNode all absent from the catalog (verified 2026-08-22); LORA_MODEL's only consumer is the LoRA model loader, in-graph. Anything trained on Cloud evaporates with the job.
_pipeline.captioning: Per-image captions confirmed supported — MakeTrainingDataset has an optional `texts` (STRING) input accepting a list of length n matching the image batch. Caption strip pass is mandatory before sidecar write (see art contract §Caption law).
